verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials to an agent is a fair question for an API platform with a programmatic API, CLI, and MCP server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. Team, workspace, and element role permissions (postman-docs-14) and Postman Vault secret storage (postman-docs-15) are adjacent controls, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
